Project rules summary:
- Better Auth is the auth source of truth.
- Supabase is server-side for private data.
- Use CSS custom properties for component visuals.
- Default to dark mode.
- Keep spacing on the 4px grid.
- Use GSAP for entrance animation and Lenis for smooth scrolling.
